name: DhirDhar Solution v2.1.1
changelog:
DhirDhar Solution v2.1.1 Release Notes:

### Dashboard
- Outstanding Overview calculated strictly year-wise for the selected year.
- Opening, New Loans, Payments, and Closing isolated for the selected year.
- Zero-transaction years display strictly ₹0.00 for all cards and zero-height bars across all 12 months.
- Interest calculated for ACTIVE borrowers only using authoritative interest engine.
- Increased chart scale support up to ₹10,00,000 (10 Lakh).
- Four grouped vertical bars per month (New Loans = Orange, Withdrawals = Red, Deposits = Green, Interest Earned = Blue).

### Year Selector & Live Update
- Seamless single year selector.
- Real-time updates without application restart.

### Installer
- Windows x64 production installer: DhirDhar-2.1.1-x64-Setup.exe.
- Version 2.1.1.
